0c5e7bfa-587d-4b21-9229-4845cf398a16.text: 🏆 Disproof #163: Graffiti.pc / Written on the Wall II conjecture **64** (DeLaViña, 25 March 2004 — open 22 years) is FALSE. It claimed f(G) ≥ ⌈√(α(G)·(1 + n mod Δ(G)))⌉ for the forest number f. Flagship counterexample: the 8-regular circulant **C₁₅(1,2,4,5)** — Δ=8, n mod Δ=7, α=5, largest induced forest f=6, but RHS = ⌈√40⌉ = 7. Four more order-15 siblings have the identical profile. Two infinite families make it fail without limit: **Bₐ** (two cliques Kₐ joined by a 2-factor) has f frozen at **4** forever while RHS = ⌈√n⌉ → ∞, so the ratio RHS/f is unbounded; and **M(k)** (k cliques K₃₂ with difference-set joins) has an additive gap ≈ n/17, verified out to **n = 1024**. Standing: **162 → 163**. Verifier `verify/verify_wow2_64.py`, stdlib only, EXIT 0: [link to gitlab.com — details withheld]
